chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The best of your women is the one of pleasant fragrance and good food, who, if she spends, spends in a proper manner, and if she withholds, withholds in a proper manner.
Such a woman is among the workers of Allah, and the worker of Allah does not fail.

key_terms.الطَّيِّبَةُ الرِّيحِ: pleasant in fragrance; marked by cleanliness and agreeable presence
key_terms.الطَّيِّبَةُ الطَّعَامِ: good in food; one who prepares wholesome and good food
key_terms.بِمَعْرُوفٍ: in a proper and recognized good manner; appropriately and with fairness
key_terms.خَيْرُ: the best; the most excellent in rank and quality
key_terms.عُمَّالِ اللَّهِ: workers of Allah; those acting in devoted obedience to Allah
key_terms.لَا يَخِيبُ: does not fail; is not disappointed or deprived of success
key_terms.نِسَائِكُمُ: your women; the women being addressed in the community

ai.seo_question: What qualities does Imam عليه السلام describe as the best traits of women?
ai.summary: This hadith praises a woman whose conduct combines personal grace, good household management, and balanced financial judgment. It presents proper spending and proper restraint as marks of righteousness, and counts such a woman among those who work for Allah.
